name: Phantom Inventory Sensor
reads: Automatically cleans, de-skews, and aligns wide-angle shelf photos uploaded by field reps Connected CPG systems: Manhattan WMS · SAP EWM · DMS Stock.
does: Counts brand facings, detects eye-level placements, and calculates exact Share-of-Shelf vs. competitors (Vertex AI Multimodal Vision Object & Facing Detection + Share-of-Shelf Planogram Compliance Classifier).
returns: Compares detected facings against contractual retailer planogram terms and computes approved visibility payouts Stages policy-checked action via Store Planogram Audit Scorecard, Retailer Visibility Incentive Approval & Penalty Dispute Memo.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved Manhattan WMS ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
